comments.author: @SuzanneStutzle
comments.text: I live in Queensland, Australia and can't imagine living in either darkness or light.  Perhaps since we have more light here I'd survive a bit better in the light but then again the summer would be very cold for me after the tropics of Queensland.  I think if I lived to my normal sleeping time of going to bed at 9pm and getting up at 6pm I would survive.  But I don't know.  I would like to experience it.

replies.author: @HappyTravel99
replies.text: Coming from tropical Queensland, Northern Norway would certainly be quite a change! Keeping a regular sleep schedule and using good blackout curtains would probably make the endless summer daylight much easier to handle. The cooler temperatures might be the bigger adjustment for you! We hope you get the chance to experience the midnight sun at least once. If you did, would you choose Northern Norway or Svalbard for your first trip?

comments.author: @traveldocumentary-t7v
comments.text: The phrase 'midnight becomes a direction, not a darkness' at [03:21] is pure poetry.
